user.title: Connect a heating account
user.description: Choose the brand of the mobile app that is already linked to the heating system. Select **Bosch** for the Bosch app or **Buderus** for the Buderus app. The app brand matters more than the logo on the appliance.

auth.title: Sign in with SingleKey ID
auth.description:
SingleKey ID is the same sign-in used by your Bosch or Buderus app. Use the same email address or mobile number and password. You do not need a new account, and you do **not** enter your password in Home Assistant.

1. Keep this dialog open and open [SingleKey ID]({authorization_url}) in a new Chrome tab. Always use this newly generated link.
2. Press `F12` there and open **Console** in the developer tools.
3. Sign in with the SingleKey ID credentials used by your heating app.
4. A network-problem message may appear after sign-in. In this case it normally only means that Chrome could not open the `{redirect_scheme}://` app address.
5. Find the red **Failed to launch** or **Connecting to** message in the console. Right-click the blue `{redirect_scheme}://` address in that message and choose **Copy link address**.
6. Return to this dialog, paste the complete address below, and select **OK**. The field may display dots for security.

Use the address from this exact sign-in attempt and do not copy only the `code` parameter. The complete address contains a short-lived one-time code. Never share it in an issue, chat, screenshot, or log.

auth_wait.title: Wait before signing in again
auth_wait.description: SingleKey ID is temporarily limiting sign-in requests. Wait at least another {seconds} seconds, then select **Submit**. The next step will provide a new sign-in link.

retry.title: Retry gateway discovery
retry.description: Sign-in succeeded, but the device list could not be loaded. Check the Home Assistant internet connection, wait a moment, and try again.

gateways.title: Select devices
gateways.description: Select the gateways and additional devices that Home Assistant should use. The final characters help distinguish devices. Available readings and controls depend on the model and the capabilities reported by the device.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The saved authorization is no longer valid. Repeat SingleKey ID sign-in. Your existing device selection will be kept.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure and rediscover
reconfigure.description: Choose the app brand, gateways, and polling profile. Saving reloads the integration and performs a complete resource discovery. Use this after a firmware update or when circuits, hot water systems, heat sources, or gateways have changed. **Standard** reads current operating values every minute. **Cloud-friendly** reduces cloud traffic by reading them every two minutes and all other changing values less often. Changing the app brand requires a new SingleKey ID sign-in.

reconfigure_retry.title: Retry gateway discovery
reconfigure_retry.description: The current gateway list could not be loaded. Check the Home Assistant internet connection, wait a moment, and select **Submit**.

error.auth_expired: This sign-in attempt has expired. Open the new SingleKey ID link shown above and sign in again.
error.auth_restart: This sign-in attempt can no longer be used. Open the new SingleKey ID link shown above and sign in again.
error.cannot_connect: The PointT service cannot be reached. Check the internet connection, wait a moment, and try again.
error.invalid_auth: SingleKey ID rejected or expired the authorization. Use the new SingleKey ID link shown above and repeat sign-in.
error.invalid_redirect: Home Assistant could not use this address. Copy the complete app address from the Chrome console's ‘Failed to launch’ message. It must begin with the scheme shown above and belong to the current sign-in attempt.
error.gateway_changed: The gateway list changed while this dialog was open. Close the dialog and open Reconfigure again.
error.select_gateway: Select at least one device from the list before continuing.
error.unknown: An unexpected PointT error occurred. Wait a moment and try again.
error.bacon_unavailable: The additional cloud device list is currently unavailable. Wait at least one minute and try again.
error.bacon_selection_unavailable: Additional cloud devices could not be queried at this time. You can select reachable heating gateways. Existing cloud device selections will be preserved.

abort.already_configured: This heating account or at least one selected gateway is already configured in Home Assistant.
abort.invalid_flow: This setup session is incomplete or expired. Close the dialog and add Bosch/Buderus Home Comfort again.
abort.no_gateways: No devices were found. Check that the selected brand and SingleKey ID account match your app.
abort.reauth_required: The saved authorization is no longer valid. Close this dialog and select Reauthenticate for Bosch/Buderus Home Comfort.
abort.reauth_wrong_account: The selected account does not match the configured devices. Sign in with the original account.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The settings were saved. Bosch/Buderus Home Comfort is reloading and discovering all available resources again.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Heating system faults appear under the bell in Home Assistant. For multiple installations, select those you want notifications for. Notifications and dismissals are shared by all users. Their text uses the system language. Dismissing a notification does not acknowledge a fault on the appliance. New or more critical faults appear again. Changes take effect immediately.

holidays.title: Manage holiday periods
holidays.description: Create a holiday or select an existing one to change its name, dates and heating settings, or delete it. The Holiday periods calendar remains available too.

delete_holiday.title: Delete holiday
delete_holiday.description:
**{holiday}**

Delete this holiday completely? It will also be removed from the heating system and the calendar. Leave the confirmation unchecked to return without deleting.

holiday.title: Holiday period
holiday.description: Set the name, period and settings. Choose quarter-hour times: minutes 00, 15, 30 or 45. Normal operation resumes at the end.

holiday_gateway.title: Choose installation
holiday_gateway.description: Choose the installation for the new holiday.

new_holiday.title: Holiday period
new_holiday.description: Set the name, period and settings. Choose quarter-hour times: minutes 00, 15, 30 or 45. Normal operation resumes at the end.

legacy_holiday.title: Holiday period
legacy_holiday.description: Adjust **{holiday}**. This device stores whole holiday days. The end date is the first day after the holiday. Times and custom names are not supported. Only settings and free holiday slots reported by the device are offered.

new_legacy_holiday.title: Holiday period
new_legacy_holiday.description: Choose the dates and settings. This device stores whole holiday days. The end date is the first day after the holiday. Times and custom names are not supported. Only settings and free holiday slots reported by the device are offered.

holiday_mode.title: Configure holiday
holiday_mode.description: This device provides a holiday mode that can be switched on and off. It does not store holiday periods.

rrc_programs.title: Select heating schedule
rrc_programs.description: Choose an existing weekly schedule. It may be shared by several zones.

rrc_schedule.title: View heating schedule

rrc_readonly.title: View heating schedule

rrc_point.title: Edit switch point
rrc_point.description:
**{program}**

Choose a time in five-minute steps and a temperature from 5 to 30 °C in 0.5 °C steps. The time repeats weekly in the heating system's local time. Changes affect all assigned zones.

operate.title: Operate appliance
operate.description: Choose a section and adjust the settings. Apply writes only your changes. When changing several settings, each is confirmed individually.

error.rrc_not_confirmed: The change could not be confirmed. It may already have been saved. Reopen the schedule and check its current settings.

repeated_rate_limit.title: Bosch/Buderus cloud requests are being limited

confirm.title: Use cloud-friendly polling
confirm.description: Select **Submit** to switch this integration to the cloud-friendly polling profile. Current operating values will then be read every two minutes instead of every minute; control and energy values every ten minutes; slow counters every thirty minutes. The integration reloads and performs a complete resource discovery.

abort.entry_not_found: The affected Bosch/Buderus Home Comfort entry no longer exists.

incompatible_firmware.title: PointT capabilities changed after a firmware update

confirm.title: Rediscover PointT capabilities
confirm.description: Bosch/Buderus Home Comfort found {conflict_count} known capabilities whose data type or unit no longer matches the safely supported PointT schema. Select **Submit** to reload the integration and inspect all capabilities again. If the warning returns, download the integration diagnostics and report the changed schema without sharing credentials or raw values.

abort.entry_not_found: The affected Bosch/Buderus Home Comfort entry no longer exists.
